## Native controller transition requirements

| Closure | Available independent data | Maintained native comparison contract |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HTTP |25 normalized original wire rows | Exact status/body/interim/stable headers; only Date/Server excluded as original; rerun original route/parser/length/HEAD/Continue assertions against native wire. |
| Terminal |source result/wire/invocation/cleanup | Metadata, environment/cwd, control-byte, resize, replay/history, detach/reset/exit relations. PIDs must bind to actual owned shell, never be erased wholesale; normalize only known cwd/PID roles and retain real process cleanup checks. |
| Support |source HTTP/wire/webhooks/static/result/expiry | Dynamic session/PIN/ports/command IDs bind through explicit role maps; preserve authorization failures, viewer/controller, owner absence, approvals/rejections/effects, typing,15-second expiry14..18s, peer/listener closure and webhook payload relationships. |
| CWP |14 source scenarios, exact result/requests/proof | Bind temporary params/root and port roles only; preserve enabled/registered/alias effects, sentinel identity, headers/payload, retries and2s/5s timing assertions using live native requests. |
| Upload |16 modes and3 HTTP action source projections | Exact normalized result and ordered requests; only timestamp/filename and declared path roles normalize. Retain multipart binary hashes/sizes, token/headers, redirect/error/truncation contracts and actual owned-recipient effects. |
| Lifecycle |source race observations | Historical source race is an observation, not a native pass oracle. Independently require24 resets, old-reader closure, owned leader/two-level descendants and server-shutdown disappearance before harness cleanup. |
| Shutdown |no source-oracle expectation | Existing original controller exercises native cancellation. Preserve independent lifecycle relationships and pending-tunnel start/release ownership; do not relabel native observation as original response. |
| Actions |incomplete, omitted | Obtain complete original all-phase capture after worker diagnoses failure. Preserve repository/ref/remote/worktree, rebuild, tmux, terminal/reboot ownership and actual side-effect comparisons. No native-derived fill-ins. |

The existing functions still require live original controllers and are not
closed by this data adapter. Parent must register original_fixture, convert
callers to consume authenticated source-only data, and add strict dynamic-role
bindings and live native effects above. A complete independent actions capture
must replace the explicit partial status. Then one grouped hosted closure gate
must execute all eight native controllers with retained original source pins,
no original execution, and explicit checkout/private-root source-absence
controls. Keep shared runtime/source dependencies explicit before deletion.
Reuse unchanged accepted observations; do not rerun per-file heavy checks.

Raw terminal/support wire includes dynamic session traffic. Comparing those
packets byte-for-byte or stripping every variable-looking string would both be
incorrect; the original independently asserted relations remain mandatory.

## Adapter API for the frozen-controller worker

`OriginalFixture::open()` authenticates all89 records. `observation(name)`
returns parsed JSON; `observation_bytes(name)` preserves original JSON/base64
wire bytes and large-integer spelling. `provenance(name)` exposes the archived
member SHA and exact source-field projection. `scenarios(name, expected_names)`
requires a complete, unique caller-specified scenario roster and refuses mixed
native fields. `original_input_sha256(path)` binds historical input identities
without requiring the retired source to exist. `require_complete_family()`
always rejects this partial snapshot. The paired helper's native fields are
never needed to consume these source rows.

No API silently normalizes dynamic values. Callers bind each historical PID,
owned path, session/PIN/port or command ID to a current value of the same role;
repeated occurrences must map consistently and distinct live identities must
remain distinct. Wire base64 is decoded before checking the declared field,
not regex-rewritten globally. Check PID ownership and process state against
the live process, and compare actual packet/text/effect fields that are not
explicitly dynamic. Lifecycle races and native shutdown/cleanup are independent
relationships; they do not make this source capture incomplete in the sense
of requiring a fake original successful native-shutdown response.

## Exact actions update procedure (awaiting accepted focused capture)

1. Record focused run, diagnostic workflow commit, source commit, artifact ID,
   full ZIP SHA, member count and all-member CRC check. Require controller
   exit0 and summary phase=all, pass=true, paired_scenarios=36 and
   native_cleanup_scenarios=1. Those fields establish capture completeness,
   not permission to turn native responses into source expectations. Check
   all original controller/helper/server/repo-update input pins against the
   capture source and before/after receipts. If any original implementation
   pin changed, explicitly assess which old observations remain reusable.
2. Require all24 primary scenarios named in actions_control::SCENARIOS and
   all12 extras. Import only each `<scenario>/source-evidence/reply.json`,
   `repository.json`, source command stdout/stderr/exit/effect receipts, and
   typed request payload from comparison.json. Record each source member's
   original size/hash and each JSON projection's full member hash and pointer.
   Copy no source/native checkout trees, tools, scripts or executable bytes.
   Actual byte/text logs may be encoded as sealed observation data.
3. Project comparison input metadata only: scenario,payload and source exit.
   Never import native-evidence replies/repositories, native exits, native
   package-attempt, response_equal/repository_equal booleans, staged_contract
   or native command strings as an original oracle. Preserve source-only
   before/after refs, branch/head/tracked/remote and source shell command
   bytes. Import source tmux response/log bytes and tmux variants' source
   observed result/bytes; source reboot reply/program invocation/reap receipts;
   source rebuild effects; source inherited_pty/terminal.json.
4. Preserve deliberate native adaptations as independently asserted current
   relationships, not historical equality: staged verbs, no destructive
   command strings, unchanged tracked/head on failed matching-package install,
   exit75 lock cases, exit17 stage-unavailable cases, fetch retaining spare
   refs, corrected bin9208 remote, no scons/sudo/deletion effects, exact
   package-attempt argv, injection absence. The original destructive behavior
   is a negative control. Native reboot_shutdown leader/descendant cleanup
   with unrelated-process survival is a live contract, not original data.
5. Add an actions-specific provenance block to a new immutable fixture
   revision; retain the existing78 observation bytes/seals unchanged. Do not
   overwrite their source commit/artifact with the new actions provenance.
   Review the exact added names and projected field list, update compiled
   outer fixture pin/roster bounds, and independently compare every added
   source observation to the sealed ZIP member/projection.
6. Only remove the explicit actions missing marker after all36 source pairs
   are present and each native effect counterpart exists. Replace the other
   two missing notes with typed coverage (`historical-race-observation` and
   `native-live-relationship`) once the lifecycle worker installs those strict
   relationships. Complete admission requires all eight closure contracts,
   not eight source-success snapshots. Run one grouped hosted acceptance gate
   after caller transition; delete original sources only in the parent's
   explicit postdelete phase. No original execution is permitted in that gate.
